description:
Founded in 1367, the University of Pécs is one of Europe’s oldest and most prestigious institutions, hosting over 29,000 students across 10 faculties and 500+ programs. Ranked in the top 700 globally by QS World University Rankings, the university combines cutting-edge research with a vibrant student life in the UNESCO-listed city of Pécs, a cultural hub with Ottoman heritage and modern European charm.

Global Accreditation: The Medical School is accredited by the World Health Organization (WHO), the US Department of Education, and the General Medical Council (UK).

Dual Degrees: Partnered with Middlesex University (UK) for dual diplomas in Business and Engineering.

The University of Pécs offers a wide range of English-taught programs designed to meet the needs of international students. Here are some of the most sought-after programs:

The 6-year Medicine program is one of the university’s flagship offerings. Accredited by the WHO and recognized in the EU, US, and Canada, this program provides students with a solid foundation in medical sciences and hands-on clinical training. Graduates are eligible to take licensing exams like the USMLE (United States) and PLAB (United Kingdom).
